name: Clean up Cloudflare Tunnel connections
description: Clean up Cloudflare Tunnel connections Removes a connection (aka Cloudflare Tunnel Connector) from a Cloudflare Tunnel independently of its current state. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel_id}/connections
context:
DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel_id}/connections
Removes a connection (aka Cloudflare Tunnel Connector) from a Cloudflare Tunnel independently of its current state. If no connector id (client_id) is provided all connectors will be removed. We recommend running this command after rotating tokens.
Required: account_id (path); tunnel_id (path)
Optional: client_id (query)

name: Get Tunnel configuration
description: Get Tunnel configuration Retrieves the configuration for a remotely managed Cloudflare Tunnel. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel_id}/configurations
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel_id}/configurations
Retrieves the configuration for a remotely managed Cloudflare Tunnel.
Required: account_id (path); tunnel_id (path)

name: Update Tunnel configuration
description: Update Tunnel configuration Replaces the configuration for a remotely managed Cloudflare Tunnel, including its ingress rules and origin request settings. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel_id}/configurations
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel_id}/configurations
Replaces the configuration for a remotely managed Cloudflare Tunnel, including its ingress rules and origin request settings.
Required: account_id (path); tunnel_id (path); body (body)

name: Create a Cloudflare Tunnel
description: Create a Cloudflare Tunnel Creates a remotely or locally managed Cloudflare Tunnel in an account. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel
Creates a remotely or locally managed Cloudflare Tunnel in an account. After creation, retrieve its token and run cloudflared to establish the connector connection.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete a Cloudflare Tunnel
description: Delete a Cloudflare Tunnel Permanently deletes a Cloudflare Tunnel from an account. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel_id}

name: Get a Cloudflare Tunnel
description: Get a Cloudflare Tunnel Fetches a single Cloudflare Tunnel. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel_id}

name: Get a Cloudflare Tunnel management token
description: Get a Cloudflare Tunnel management token Creates a short-lived management token for the requested Tunnel management resources, such as streaming logs. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel_id}/management
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel_id}/management
Creates a short-lived management token for the requested Tunnel management resources, such as streaming logs. Treat the token as a secret.
Required: account_id (path); tunnel_id (path); body (body)

name: Get a Cloudflare Tunnel token
description: Get a Cloudflare Tunnel token Retrieves the token used to run cloudflared and associate it with a specific Cloudflare Tunnel. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel_id}/token
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel_id}/token
Retrieves the token used to run cloudflared and associate it with a specific Cloudflare Tunnel. Treat the token as a secret.
Required: account_id (path); tunnel_id (path)

name: Get Cloudflare Tunnel connector
description: Get Cloudflare Tunnel connector Retrieves a connector and its connection details for a Cloudflare Tunnel, including its cloudflared version, architecture, and connected Cloudflare locations. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel_id}/connectors/{connector_id}

name: List Cloudflare Tunnel connections
description: List Cloudflare Tunnel connections Lists the connections for a Cloudflare Tunnel, including connector IDs, cloudflared versions, and Cloudflare locations. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel_id}/connections
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel_id}/connections
Lists the connections for a Cloudflare Tunnel, including connector IDs, cloudflared versions, and Cloudflare locations.
Required: account_id (path); tunnel_id (path)

name: List Cloudflare Tunnels
description: List Cloudflare Tunnels Lists and filters Cloudflare Tunnels in an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel
Lists and filters Cloudflare Tunnels in an account.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: name (query); is_deleted (query); existed_at (query); uuid (query); was_active_at (query); was_inactive_at (query); include_prefix (query); exclude_prefix (query); status (query); per_page (query); page (query)

name: Update a Cloudflare Tunnel
description: Update a Cloudflare Tunnel Updates the name or secret of an existing Cloudflare Tunnel. PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel_id}
